name: Bevelled window + pointer cursor
oneLiner: A drop-in replacement for plain text boxes and menus: bevelled gradient windows that grow from their centre when they open, a pointing glove that bobs beside the selected item and slides between items, greyed-out disabled items, a target pointer for picking units, and a placement helper that keeps every window on screen and off the sprites and HUD it must not cover.
fits: any game with text boxes or command menus
notFor: games whose menus are diegetic (in-world signs, holograms)
touch-first UIs that need large thumb buttons (rows are 10-16 native px)
text-heavy games needing scrolling lists or CJK text (one page per message, English UI)

needs: a fixed 60 Hz update step (dt in ms, the module animates on it)
the screen area windows must stay inside (native px)
optional: rectangles to avoid (sprites with ids, HUD rects windows must not cover)
the host's own menu state: which menu is open, its items, which item is selected, which units are targeted
provides: window and pointer rectangles on screen (ui rects for other overlays to avoid)
itemAt(id, x, y) for tap / click hit tests on menu rows
a placement helper: place(w, h, want) -> a rect on screen and off the given rects

assets: module/window-cursor.js: the element as one dependency-free script (global GameDNA_WindowCursor): window frames, 5x7 text with punctuation, glove pointer, layout, placement, animation, drawing; draws through GameDNA_Skin when skin-api.js is loaded, otherwise with its built-in copy of the pixel16 look
